theorems.statement: AllardRectifiabilityTheorem → FirstRectifiabilityTheorem → MonotonicityFormula → (∀ (N n : ℕ) (L : ℝ), 0 < L → L ≤ 1 → ∀ (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (P : Grassmannian N n), ∃ Γ : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N), (∀ i, IsClosed (Γ i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ Γ i, ∀ z ∈ Γ i, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) ∧ ∀ (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → (∀ v : Euclidean N, ‖Grassmannian.project T v - Grassmannian.project P v‖ ≤ L / 4 * ‖v‖) → ∃ i, x ∈ Γ i) → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (θ₀ : ℝ) (W : ℕ → Varifold N n (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5)), 0 < θ₀ → (∀ k, IsIntegral (W k)) → (∀ k, (W k).HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ variationMeasure (W k) (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5)) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5 ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(W k).measure) atTop (𝓝 (θ₀ * ∫ z, f z ∂(planeVarifoldMeasure P)))) → ∃ m : ℕ, θ₀ = m
